summary: Performed a read-only audit of apps/agent-server, packages/protocol, and packages/extensions (backend/shared does not exist) to inform a refactor plan. Identified large files, mixed responsibilities, reusable extraction opportunities, the current split of tests between src and tests directories, import/config wiring, and produced prioritized phases with exact paths plus coupling and migration risks.
decisions: backend/shared path does not exist in the repository, so the audit scope is limited to apps/agent-server, packages/protocol, and packages/extensions.

Tests currently live in two locations: colocated *.test.ts inside src/ (e.g. packages/protocol/src/index.test.ts, packages/extensions/src/patch.test.ts) and a dedicated tests/ tree in apps/agent-server; the proposal is to consolidate under a tests/ folder in apps/agent-server.

Phase 1 (low-risk extractions): move pi-runtime-config.ts out of src/config/ into a new packages/config package; extract AsyncMutex from apps/agent-server/src/projects/project-catalog.ts into packages/protocol/util/async-mutex.ts.

Phase 2 (medium-risk splits): split apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts (>1300 LOC) into session-lifecycle.ts, event-translator.ts, and extensions/active-extensions.ts; split apps/agent-server/src/transport/websocket-server.ts (>800 LOC) into router.ts, auth.ts, and handlers/.

Phase 3 (coupling reduction): move activation context from packages/extensions/src/extension.ts to packages/protocol/src/extension-context.ts to remove the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent dependency from packages/extensions.
Migration risk: pi-agent-service.ts is a hub importing from sessions, attachments, projects, resources, and extensions; it must be split behind an interface to avoid circular imports.

Migration risk: websocket-server.ts currently mixes protocol parsing, auth, and handler dispatch in one file; splitting requires keeping the request/response envelope stable to preserve the ws client contract.
Migration risk: project-catalog.ts contains an internal AsyncMutex; extracting it changes no public API but requires updating the single import site.
